I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from her own messages in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. She first posted 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't find the signed amendment in the shared files, so I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to check it before the QBR.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so it didn't need approval. I also didn't mix this up with Quarendon Freightways, which is a different company and not a customer.
